claims.text: A CORRECTION TO THE DATE IN GENERAL CIRCULATION. Letterboxd lists three release dates across two territories and two formats: United States digital, 1 November 2018; United Kingdom physical, 4 December 2018; United States physical, 8 December 2018. The widely repeated '4 December 2018' is the United Kingdom physical date, not the release. IMDb returned HTTP 403 to this board on 18 September 2026 and no distributor record was opened, so the node asserts a range and not a single date.

claims.text: He appears in and is credited on Jeremy Corbell's 2018 documentary Bob Lazar: Area 51 and Flying Saucers, alongside Lazar himself and Joy White.

He directed Bob Lazar: Area 51 and Flying Saucers, 2018, 97 minutes, narrated by Mickey Rourke and featuring Bob Lazar, George Knapp and Joy White. It is the artefact that returned the S-4 claim to mass circulation thirty years after the 1989 broadcasts, and it is how the July 2017 search of United Nuclear entered the UFO literature.
